title: Formalize full Maclaurin chain M₁ ≥ M₂ ≥ ... ≥ Mₙ as a single theorem

problemStatement.formal: \forall j k : \mathbb{N}, 0 < j \to j \le k \to k \le n \to M_j(x) \ge M_k(x)
problemStatement.plain: For non-negative reals x₁,...,xₙ, the Maclaurin means satisfy M₁ ≥ M₂ ≥ ... ≥ Mₙ as a complete chain theorem proved by induction on the step gap.
whyMatters: Unifies all n-1 adjacent Maclaurin inequalities into a single transitive chain
Enables direct comparison of any two Maclaurin means without iterating through steps
The M₁ ≥ Mₙ corollary generalizes AM-GM

proven: maclaurin_full_chain: For 0 < j ≤ k ≤ n, M_j(x) ≥ M_k(x)
knownResults.goal: Complete chain theorem proved from maclaurin_step (axiom in parent)

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETED: Full Maclaurin chain proved by induction on gap d. 1 axiom: maclaurin_step from AmgmInequalityOQ02.lean.
insights: Key insight: induction on the gap d in 'j + d ≤ n' cleanly proves M_j ≥ M_{j+d} using maclaurin_step d times
Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le converts j ≤ k into j + d = k, enabling the inductive structure
